caption: The drawing depicts a single metal spur with a leather strap attached. The spur is metallic and primarily dark gray with subtle greenish-brown tones, and it has an ornate, slightly curved arm with engraved or embossed detailing near the end that would attach to a boot. The rowel, or star-shaped rotating wheel, is fixed to one end of the spur and is a dull brownish-yellow color. The leather strap, which is attached to the spur with a metal buckle and rivet, is medium brown and shows some light tan edges and the presence of stitching or punched holes. The entire object is centrally placed on a plain, off-white background, isolated without any additional elements or scenery present.
title: Spur
